column1: # bios-r2-phys.tsv -- DUMPBIOS disk round, Rwabs with RW_NOTRANSLATE
# (BIOS-STOR-002, docs/audits/2026-10-28-bios-storage.md; probe group P of
# measurements/measurement-2026-10-28-bios-storage-audit/method/bstprobe.c),
# against EmuTOS 1a7484ab (docs/analysis/ORACLE.md; TASK/TOOL07).
# The unit is the token u:0, "the physical unit of the test disk", resolved by
# each build from its profile (docs/api/bios/04-rwabs.md, "Decisions"): the
# oracle's profile disk 18 (IDE master), NewTOS 26 (the SD card).  No search,
# no literal unit number (a literal stays refused).  Physical sector 63 is C:'s
# boot sector on both sides: the test image and the NewTOS card put C: at
# LBA 63 (tools/mkcard.sh copies the image to the card's start).  The card's
# MBR differs from the image's in entry 2 (the program partition D:), so only
# entry 1 and the signature are captured.  Device-size cases (the last device
# sector, BIOS-STOR-002 probe P03/P04) are out: the image has 131072 sectors,
# the card 262144.
# WHERE IT RUNS -- as bios-r2.tsv: the oracle's profile disk
# (HATARI_ORACLE_DISK=<test.img> tools/hatari-oracle.sh disk ...) and on NewTOS
# a card from tools/mkcard.sh with MKCARD_TESTDISK (cargo xtask tosdump bios
# --disk ...). The test image: tools/mktestdisk.sh
# NEWDESK.INF=<inf>, the one of bios-r2.tsv (sha256 d95a60c3...); C: = LBA 63,
# Not destructive: reads only.
# One table per round: a case id is the physical line number and the dump
# header carries the CRC of this file, so it is frozen once measured.
!disk
# ---- Rwabs(RW_NOTRANSLATE, buf, n, recno, u:0, lrecno) -- the physical arm,
#      bios/blkdev.c:483-504 (unit, range, UNIT_CHANGED), disk_rw bios/disk.c:1177

column5: P02 physical sector 0 = the MBR, partition entry 1 -- blkdev.c:484-504
P06 physical sector 63 = C:'s boot sector, bytes 0-255 -- blkdev.c:484-504
control: C: logical sector 0, bytes 0-255 (= R01) -- blkdev.c:430-481
P07 two sectors from 63: C:'s FAT starts at 64 -- blkdev.c:484-504
P13 past any device -> ESECNF -- blkdev.c:488-490
